title: What is Power BI
q: Power BI is primarily a tool for…
why: Power BI is Microsoft's BI and reporting platform.

title: Desktop file type
q: The Power BI Desktop save file has which extension?
why: .pbix is the native Power BI Desktop file.

title: Three views
q: Which three views does Power BI Desktop provide on the left rail?

title: Report view purpose
q: You drag visuals onto the canvas in…
why: Report view is where visuals are placed and arranged.

title: Data view purpose
options: Preview the loaded table rows and columns
answer: Preview the loaded table rows and columns
why: Data view shows the imported data grid.

title: Model view purpose
options: Create and manage relationships between tables
answer: Create and manage relationships between tables
why: Model view manages the data model and relationships.

title: Where to publish
why: Publishing targets the Power BI Service / Fabric.

title: Refresh source data
q: After the source Excel changes, you update the report by…
options: Clicking Refresh on the Home tab
answer: Clicking Refresh on the Home tab
why: Home ▸ Refresh re-imports the latest data.

title: Free license name
q: The individual free authoring license is called…
why: Free/Fabric Free covers personal authoring; sharing needs Pro.

title: Pro license need
q: To share a report with colleagues in a workspace you generally need…
why: Collaboration and sharing require Pro or higher.

title: Dataset vs report
q: In the Power BI Service, a semantic model (dataset) is…
options: The data model and measures that one or more reports connect to
answer: The data model and measures that one or more reports connect to
why: Reports are thin; the semantic model holds data + measures.

title: Workspace role
q: Which workspace role can edit content but not manage access?
why: Contributor edits content; Admin/Member manage access.

title: App vs workspace
q: A Power BI App is best described as…
options: A packaged, read-optimised distribution of workspace content to consumers
answer: A packaged, read-optimised distribution of workspace content to consumers
why: Apps distribute curated content to a wide audience.

title: Fabric relationship
q: Power BI is now part of which broader Microsoft platform?
why: Power BI is the BI experience within Microsoft Fabric.

title: Deployment pipelines
q: Deployment pipelines in Premium/PPU are used to…
options: Promote content across Dev, Test and Production stages
answer: Promote content across Dev, Test and Production stages
why: Pipelines manage Dev→Test→Prod release of BI content.

title: Endorsement
q: Marking a semantic model as 'Certified' is a form of…
options: Endorsement to signal trusted, governed content
answer: Endorsement to signal trusted, governed content
why: Promoted/Certified are endorsement levels for governance.
